messages:
sam_w: Heads-up — seeing a spike in 'inspect-playback' hits from the canary fleet, and a bunch of them are not sampled out. Latency + storage going up. Anyone flip TTLs?
anya: I toggled the short-ttl flag for the canary route yesterday to 30s to reduce replay blast. I scoped it to tenant:beta but might've used the wrong environment tag. :grimacing:
mike_r: That rollout job used `env: canary,prod` by accident — I caught it halfway. Deploy logs show `rollout:inspect-short-ttl` targeted `inspect-*` patterns.
jess_p: Noted. We need a fast mitigation: either revert the flag or force sampled=true -> redact-only fallback to avoid storing PII. Which is faster?
nora_ops: Revert is straightforward but requires a canary cut. We can also flip the console 'inspect-playback:force-redact' toggle to ON; that's immediate. Console path: Console > Observability > Inspect > Fallback.
mike_r: Console toggle is immediate but UX is confusing — it shows global scope by default. That's how this slipped last week. We should have a per-environment confirmation on toggles that affect storage.
sam_w: While we decide, ops SLOs are brittle. Can we put a temporary sampling cap at the ingress (api-proxy)? Something like `max_inspect_per_minute=100` and fallback to scrubbed-metadata only.
anya: I can open a quick PR to add a proxy-level guard: in ingress-config.yaml add: ```
inspect_playback:
  per_minute_limit: 100
  on_exceed: redact_only
```
mike_r: +1 for proxy guard. Also add a warning metric `inspect_throttle_triggered` so console shows it. We keep missing signals.
jess_p: Agree. Also suggest small UX tweak: when toggling 'short-ttl' show a modal listing affected envs and the exact routes. Right now it says "applies to N routes" which is too vague.
nora_ops: For immediate triage I'm going to flip `inspect-playback:force-redact` in prod and canary. I'll comment in the rollout ticket.
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout inspect-short-ttl -> PROD aborted by nora_ops at 6109876600 :warning:
sam_w: Thanks. After that, let's run a quick audit: identify requests that were stored with TTL > 30s in the past 24h and mark for manual deletion if PII present. We may need legal loop.
anya: I have a query for that — will run off daily-archive with `where inspect_ttl > 30s and route like '%inspect%'`. Will post counts.
mike_r: Longer term: lock console toggles behind a two-step confirmation for redaction/retention changes plus an audit trail entry that emails the oncall. Low friction but safer.
jess_p: Also add a rollback playbook in the console UI: button -> "revert last retention change" which calls our orchestration API and runs a dry-run log-check before revert.
sam_w: Good. Action items: (1) nora flips force-redact (done), (2) anya PR for ingress guard, (3) mike adds metric + console alert, (4) jess files UX modal + revert-button ticket. I'll open a short-lived incident channel for the audit output.
nora_ops: Done the toggle. Posting a short status in #incidents in 5.
mike_r: I'll own metric + alert. ETA 2h.
anya: PR opened: https://git.company/infra/ingress/pulls/1234 — includes the `on_exceed: redact_only` behavior.
sam_w: Thanks team. Follow-up: short retro tomorrow — we need safer defaults for redaction-affecting toggles. :thumbsup:
